knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the client buys the treatment, the time it takes and the certainty that it will be done safely in their own space. Your hourly rate, equipment list and business age are not what the client buys.
The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford. Unlimited, undefined or impossible guarantees are not sound.

The lesson says a claim must be backed by evidence you can show, and it warns against publishing skin-result claims without evidence. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence do not support a claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
